name: Dementation (Dark Ages) — 2 Intermediate — Eyes of Chaos

system.description:
You can see behind the façade of orderly reality to the fractured, insane truth that hides behind it, allowing you to assemble patterns and understandings of events that no sane mind could, and rip aside the false face people present to see who they really are inside.

There are two uses. First, expend a Mental Trait and a turn of concentration to make a Mental Challenge; if you win, you may ask the Storyteller to predict the general result of a specific course of action for the scene. Second, after watching a person's actions for a full turn, engage him in a Mental Challenge; if you win, he must tell you his Nature.

If you lose any challenge while using Eyes of Chaos, you become entranced by the interplay of event and pattern, effectively suffering from the Toreador Clan Disadvantage for the rest of the scene.
